label: B25-PHYSICAL-SELECTOR-RERUN
title: Run fresh 25 MHz physical flow with the accepted synthesis selector
scope: Create a new exact source/MIF manifest from the accepted selector+oracle candidate, then run Quartus Prime Pro 21.4 IP generation, synthesis, fitter, signoff STA and non-destructive clock/BRAM/CDC/MIF/resource reports in serial. Confirm that SYNTHESIS selects the explicit M20K branches and that Error 19544 is gone.
launch_preconditions: Exact candidate is clean; non-doc physical inputs match 702bd8ee.
Boot image contract/checker, selector, platform, skeleton, SHA and registry closure pass before transfer.
Remote probe is absent; reject rather than delete/reuse any pre-existing database or unknown file.
Acquire gamepc and record EDA/JTAG process counts without stopping unknown processes.
validation: Rebuild boot.elf/bin/hex/mif and require WIDTH=64 DEPTH=8192/8192 records, ELF-derived oracle agreement and remote MIF hash equality.
Materialize and hash-bind canonical physical inputs plus QSF-relative aliases; require exact sole VERILOG_MACRO SYNTHESIS and exclude standalone duplicate BRAM wrapper.
Run ipgenerate+synthesis; if zero errors, run fitter then signoff STA serially with one Quartus process.

Report Error 19544 absence, lcvex_bram_boot_altsyncram/cache altera_syncram selection, M20K/MIF consumption, sys_clk_25=40 ns, Qsys/clk_y3 clocks, setup/hold/recovery/removal/min-pulse, T-045 SDC filters, DDR/metastability and resources.
acceptance: All allowed physical stages pass on the exact candidate with nonnegative timing gates and proven MIF/M20K consumption, or the first honest new blocker is preserved without retry or source modification. No assembler/bitstream/board action occurs.

resource.policy: Every remote write/heavy stage uses resource-lock gamepc; retain fresh failed probe and return 75 means wait.

forbidden_regions: RTL/QEMU/QSF/SDC/checker/test semantic changes during the run
reuse/deletion of T-006 or any previous remote database
quartus_pgm, nios2-terminal, JTAG programming, board reset/power and Flash/EPCQ writes
license content and unknown user files/processes

integrator_review.passed: synthesis/fitter/STA tools, selector/MIF/M20K, 25 MHz setup, recovery/removal/min-pulse, DDR, metastability and resources
integrator_review.blocked: EMIF response FIFO payload hold paths are not fully excepted; T-045 max-delay is overridden by false-path; two unconstrained clocks require classification
integrator_review.next: Use the frozen fitted database for report-only endpoint/exception classification before changing SDC; then validate SDC-only corrections locally and on the reused database before one final fresh physical run.

recovery.reason: User reported an abnormal local host restart; prior agent process terminated before any remote probe was created.
recovery.local_worktree: clean at 702bd8ee; task-local boot/oracle/manifest/staging artifacts preserved
recovery.remote_readonly_audit: GAMEPC online; remote probe absent; db/incremental_db/output_files absent; EDA/JTAG command set empty; free physical memory 47387.9 MiB
recovery.policy: Resume the same task after re-verifying preserved local artifacts; create the remote probe once. Do not duplicate or reuse a remote database.
